editorial_policy: Regional records describe shared agricultural, climate, infrastructure, trade, value-chain or investment systems spanning multiple African countries. Each record keeps an authoritative source and verification date.

regions.name: Southern Africa
regions.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand 2026 — Southern Africa regional agrifood investment initiative
regions.description: A regional investment framework covering shared priorities including community reservoirs and solar pumping for irrigation, mechanization hire-service hubs, agroprocessing, seed systems, and market integration and trade.
regions.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

regions.name: African Small Island Developing States
regions.title: FAO African SIDS — regional agrifood and blue-economy investment initiative
regions.description: A regional framework focused on resilient agrifood systems, blue transformation, value chains and market access, youth and women empowerment, innovation, knowledge sharing and technology transfer across participating African island states.
regions.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

regions.name: Lobito Corridor
regions.title: Lobito Corridor — food-market and agricultural trade connectivity
regions.description: A regional corridor linking Angola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Zambia. FAO's 2026 investment forum highlights its potential to connect producers with regional and international food markets through transport and logistics infrastructure.
regions.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

regions.name: Africa Science & Innovation
regions.title: Africa Science & Innovation Forum — agrifood research, technology and innovation network
regions.description: A continent-wide platform convened by FAO with partners including FARA, the African Union Commission and RUFORUM to connect research, science, innovation policy, investment and implementation. The 2026 forum focuses on productivity and value-chain optimization, sustainable resilience, science-policy systems, investment and partnerships, and inclusive innovation for farmers, women, youth and SMEs.
regions.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

regions.name: Eastern Africa
regions.title: Eastern Africa — climate finance, agribusiness and value-chain investment intelligence
regions.description: FAO's Eastern Africa work links climate and environmental finance, agribusiness, agricultural value chains, resilience, market systems and investment-ready pipelines. Current 2026 work includes country climate-finance action plans and draft investment pipelines for 2027–2030.
regions.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

regions.name: West Africa
regions.title: West Africa — agrifood productivity, resilience, water and market systems
regions.description: FAO's West Africa programme covers agricultural policy, food security, sustainable agriculture, climate adaptation, water and soil management, livestock, fisheries, resilience, digital innovation, market systems and value chains across the subregion.
regions.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

regions.name: Central Africa
regions.title: Central Africa — production, food security, natural resources and regional integration
regions.description: FAO's Central Africa office supports agricultural policy, crop and livestock production, fisheries, forestry and natural-resource management, food and nutrition security and emergency resilience, while working with regional integration institutions.
regions.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
